contribution.position: Holding my earlier position. I am answering ops, who claims the rollback rehearsal finished cleanly with zero data loss and so the rollback path is proven. That claim cites artifact:rollback-rehearsal-q3, which does not appear in the artifact list, and ops listed no anchors. The only artifact on this point, artifact:ops-runbook, says no rollback rehearsal has been run for the rebuild job. Until a rehearsal record exists, the recovery path is untested, and I treat the ops claim as unsupported. I also answer qa, who says risk is contained based on 412 passed, 0 failed. I accept that result, but it is not a retry-storm or failure-injection result. artifact:incident-log attributes both sev2 incidents last quarter to retry storms, and artifact:perf-report covers p99 at peak load only. Two items would settle this: a retry-storm or failure-injection result for the rebuild job, and either the real rehearsal record or one rehearsed rollback with a timing measurement. I am not weighing cost or schedule, and this is advisory input only.
